research_owner: Independent Yggdrasil contributor on existing PR #1327; only Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work PR #1278 coordinates canonical integration.
question: Can a bounded tokenless two-regime outcome memory learn from genuinely uncertain single-world action consequences, preserve earlier task memory through disjoint updates, and regain competence when a previous causal regime recurs?

predecessor.know19_limit: Binary any-reduction label source-computable, trained full public input table, strongest-control tie 10/12; no outcome-dependent utility knowledge

source_boundary.sensor_description: Public scene ID and binary action plus witnessed binary reward. Hidden best arm, active regime and exogenous noise are NEVER supplied to learner/policies.
source_boundary.regime_truth: For each private scene initial role r in {0,1}, optimal arm r for t=0..15 and t=32..47; opposite arm for t=16..31; neither switch indicator nor phase supplied to any non-oracle policy.
source_boundary.outcome_law: Bernoulli p=0.8 for current optimal action, p=0.2 otherwise; fixed common-random-number u(seed,t) generated by SHA256 with one private domain separation string, identical across compared policies, independent of chosen action; reward = int(u<p).
source_boundary.source_only_test: Same public source for role0 and role1; no effect from public scene ID except storage namespace; world role and noise cannot enter policy features.

budgets.fit_actions: Alternating action t%2; exactly 96 separate synthetic FIT A outcomes and 96 FIT B outcomes; separate scene addresses
budgets.policy_restart: Every held world begins a fresh native/classic empty per-scene ledger; FIT scene state remains separately checkpointed as retention evidence, not shared as latent-role lookup
budgets.compute: Python standard library, CPU only, no model/paid API

mechanism.name: Research-only NativeSparseRegimeMemory; not part of accepted Yggdrasil or original native checkpoint
mechanism.storage: Per-scene two fixed Bernoulli count slots for each binary action, each slot Beta(1,1) posterior; preserve old slot upon regime switch
mechanism.choice: Select arm with higher current slot posterior mean, tie choose action 0
mechanism.surprise: Anomalous witness iff forecast selected-action success p>=0.65 and reward0, or p<=0.35 and reward1. Maintain last 6 anomaly indicators, switch active memory slot when >=3 anomalies of last 6 AND at least 8 witnessed samples since last switch. Exactly one slot toggle per switch, no resetting stored slot.
mechanism.cold_restore: Canonical JSON with independent expected SHA256, source mode checks, strict keys, duplicate scene/event denial, repeat receipt idempotence only if byte-identical, fixed scene and step bounds
mechanism.learning: Each sequential action observation increments one success/trial count in active scene/slot only; learns probabilities from witnessed outcomes, never source-computable usefulness labels.

controls: independent stationary per-scene Beta(1,1) counts; all observations
surprise-gated reset-on-switch Beta with same anomaly threshold/tie rule, but prior regime counts discarded

two-state Bayesian HMM with hazard=1/16, Bernoulli 0.8/0.2 emission likelihood, UNKNOWN current state; same observed actions/outcomes; assumes the 2-state mechanism and known noise rates; strong model-informed comparator
seeded random binary actions, no role-dependent RNG
perfect truth-aware oracle upper ceiling; explicitly unlearned, excluded from strongest-control claim

metrics.primary: Mean expected regret per HELD policy (sum 0.6 for each wrong arm across 576 policy actions /576), lower is better; fixed private truth only evaluator can inspect
secondary: prequential Brier for each policy's own chosen-action forecast
old 96 A fit predictions before/after disjoint B and after cold restore
new scene cold isolation and exact checkpoint reconstitution
whole proof local wall-clock, total observed actions and checkpoint bytes

engineering_gate.pass_if: zero A forecast changes after B and cold restore, source/type/duplicate/tamper negative controls pass; held policies get exactly their 576 permitted witnessed actions; native selected actions depend on actual witnessed rewards in at least one controlled counterfactual; metric reporting complete; no internal policy reads role/phase/noise
engineering_gate.not_required: Do NOT require winning outcome to pass engineering; SCIENCE and engineering separate.

development_hypothesis.comparison: NativeSparseRegimeMemory reduces expected held regret vs stationary Beta by at least 0.03 absolute; exceeds or ties gated reset at return segment by not forgetting earlier slot; strongest Bayesian HMM or rolling win is reported honestly.
development_hypothesis.classify: MECHANISM_SUPPORTED_DEVELOPMENT only if native improvement >=0.03 vs stationary and return-segment native regret <= gated reset; otherwise NO_GO or MIXED. Never claim SCIENTIFIC_PASS from synthetic study.

science_gate: Scientific PASS requires separately owner-authorized ORIGINAL-world first-use, preregistered disjoint causal-law transfer, original native model integration, strongest matched conventional/Bayesian baseline advantage, reproducibility, whole-process cost and cold retention; current study categorically is DEV_ONLY.
stop_rules: One fixed held cohort, no post-result threshold/seed/probability/scene/horizon/action-budget changes; record negatives; only implementation defects may be corrected without changing frozen evidence/scoring, and invalidate prior scorings transparently.
governance: Research source/code/tests/evidence on existing PR1327 only; no new PR or controller, no owner runner, canonical checkpoint, merge, protected first use, paid API, scheduled task, acceptance or deployment.
